text:
tom: Heads-up — PrimeCare returned the vendor risk form with two blockers: BYOK/KMS provenance question unanswered and SOC2 evidence for nonprod masking missing. They flagged renewal health as 'at risk' if we can't provide answers by EOD Fri.
alana: thanks for flagging. is this the same tenant from onboarding (primecare-prod-us)?
tom: yes — onboarding started last month, they hit internal audit. they want: 1) BYOK key provenance details, 2) data masking for nonprod + attestation, 3) confirmation we retain embeddings only as per DPA addendum.
ben: I can draft the technical answers for KMS and masking. need the exact key lifecycle notes. ops-bot: Reminder: runbook link for BYOK -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok :memo:
alana: pairing request — i need sample config + whether nonprod has masked embeddings. I think nonprod uses pseudonymization, but need the attestation language from legal.
anya: legal here — we can provide a standard BYOK provenance statement but need to confirm if customer provided key material or we generated and wrapped it. which flow did PrimeCare choose?	om: they selected 'customer-provided' during setup and uploaded a public key reference. I can pull the onboarding artifacts.
ben: ok drafting snippet. preliminary text:
```
KMS: Customer-supplied key (BYOK) was registered via our onboarding portal on 2026-02-18. Redwood stores key metadata only (key_id, wrapping_key_fingerprint) and performs cryptographic operations without retaining key material. Audit logs available on request.
Nonprod: Data in non-production environments is pseudonymized; embeddings stored in isolated buckets with access controls and 90-day retention by default per DPA addendum.
```
alana: that looks good. can you add where the audit logs live (S3 path) and attach a redacted sample? tom can pull the artifact.
anya: legal edits: replace 'without retaining key material' -> 'does not persist customer key material beyond registration and wrapping'. also need explicit acceptance clause for embedding retention override (customer must sign addendum).
tom: pulling artifacts now. give me 10.
ops-bot: Artifact fetched: s3://redwood-onboarding/primecare/keys/metadata.json :link:
alana: great. I'll validate masking config against dev cluster this afternoon and confirm whether we can provide the masking attestation template.
ben: will finalize tech answers and attach to the vendor form draft. planning to send to PrimeCare PM by 18:00 PT.
anya: legal can review and sign off once Ben attaches the final wording. if we miss EOD Fri, escalate to AM for renewal hold conversation.
tom: noted. scheduling a quick sync at 3pm PT to close the loop. please drop any last items in this thread before then. :calendar:
alana: adding checklist for sync:
- confirm key provenance file (tom)
- attach redacted audit log (ops-bot/tom)
- confirm nonprod masking and attestation text (alana)
- legal wording for addendum + embedding retention override (anya)
- final vendor form upload (ben)
ben: will upload to the vendor portal and ping PM when done. :thumbsup:
tom: thanks — keeping this tracked in renewal tracker (account health = at-risk -> target resolved). will update once sent.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: sync at 2026-03-26T15:00:00-07:00 (3pm PT) :bell:
anya: if we get this done before EOD Fri we can avoid escalation. leaning in.
